# `project.frames.set`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/project.frames.set.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`project.frames.set` (`SetFrameDefaults`): sets the frame defaults of the project (doc 03 §5.1 `FrameDefaults`,
FR-PAG-018): the frame form of a drawn page whose `form` is unset is the entry of its page type, else
`default`; a section divider takes the entry of `section_divider`; generated report pages keep the form of
their block.

The parameters are the whole new value of `default` and `per_page_type`, stored in the settings member
`FRAMES_MEMBER`: `per_page_type` always (an empty list when there is no entry, doc 03 §5.1), in page-type
order, and `default` when given. The member's other contents (members of a newer format) are kept (doc 05
§10.3); when there is no default, no entry and nothing else, the member is removed, so the built-in frames apply
again. Each form must be an embedded form copy (else `CmdError::NotFound`) of kind `frame`, `cover` or
`divider` (else invalid at its pointer). Rejected at `/per_page_type/i/page_type`: a page type named twice,
`report` (report pages take their block's form, EW-INV-012) and a type of a newer format. Rejected: a settings
member `FRAMES_MEMBER` that is not an object (a newer or damaged format; it is never overwritten).
The cell mapping of the title block is part of the form copies (`library.embed`); this command does not edit
forms. Only the project record changes. Bulk: one stored value changes the frame of every page that has no
form of its own. Undoable as one step. Outcome: none.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `default` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The frame form of drawn pages whose type has no entry; absent: none (the built-in frame applies). |
| `per_page_type` | array of [`FrameForPageType`](#frameforpagetype) | no |  | The frame form per page type, at most one entry per type. |

## Types

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### FrameForPageType

One `per_page_type` entry of the frame defaults.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `form` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The frame form copy for pages of that type. |
| `page_type` | [`PageType`](#pagetype) | yes |  | The page type the entry applies to. |

### PageType

Page type (FR-PAG-001). `report` pages are always generated, never stored.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"title_page"` | Title page (cover form). |
| `"table_of_contents"` | Table of contents. |
| `"section_divider"` | Section divider. |
| `"graphic"` | Graphic page without electrical meaning. |
| `"single_line"` | Single-line diagram. |
| `"multi_line"` | Multi-line schematic. |
| `"overview"` | Overview. |
| `"bus_topology"` | Bus topology. |
| `"fluid"` | Fluid-power schematic. |
| `"assembly_overview"` | Assembly overview. |
| `"panel_layout"` | Panel layout. |
| `"model_view"` | 3D model view. |
| `"external_document"` | External document. |
| `"report"` | Report (generated only). |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

This is a bulk command: a log line runs it as a preview first and commits the previewed result ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)).
